messages:
Hannah: Heads-up: Channel partner NeonPulse spotted a promo stacking bug that credited merchants twice for Feb usage. They want a consolidated refund/adjustment.
Marco: How many merchants and what's the total?
Hannah: NeonPulse sent the export. 11 merchants impacted, gross liability = $6,880 after proration. Sample pasted: `inv-7643,AlphaApps,2025-02,$1,200,$600,$600` (charged, should_have, delta).
Leah: Is this a refund to the merchants or a partner-level correction? Partner agreement says partners can handle allocation; they asked for partner-level credit.
Owen: Ops preference: issue a lump-sum credit memo to NeonPulse, they distribute. Need approver and GL. Also check whether this triggers any tax handling.
Hannah: Can we use GL `GL-PARTNER-ADJ`?
Leah: Approved. Amount: $6,880. Memo: "NeonPulse double-promo correction Feb 2025". Approver: Leah (finance lead).
finance-bot: Created ticket FIN-5002. Status: awaiting NeonPulse signed ack and sample CSV. Link: https://redwood.internal/fin/tickets/FIN-5002
Marco: CFO looped in via DM; amount < $10k so finance lead approval sufficient. Schedule posting 2025-03-28 EOD for accrual alignment.
Hannah: I'll request NeonPulse sign the allocation ack (one-pager) and provide payment routing preference (wire vs credit memo).
NeonPulse (via Hannah): They prefer a credit memo. Asked for ref `NP-FEB-DUP-2025`.
Owen: Great. I'll draft the credit memo and include their ref. Will attach CSV and ack to FIN-5002. ETA posting after ack tomorrow.
Marco: Add note to month-end close: "Partner credit to NeonPulse for promo stacking correction, $6,880."
Hannah: Also filed product request P-1310 to add a promo-validation gate on partner onboarding.
finance-bot: FIN-5002 updated: attachments required = CSV, NeonPulse ack PDF, approval thread link.
Owen: Will confirm here once the credit memo is posted. :white_check_mark:
